title: Entitled Brat Goes Ballistic On Police After Getting Kicked Out Of Bar
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 24th, 2024. Officers were called to a bar regarding a highly intoxicated woman who refused to leave the bar after entering the men’s bathroom. When security & Police tried to tell her to leave, she refused and continued to ask why she was being arrested. The lady was extremely rude and belligerent. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
